common.brandFull: Egyptian Italian Company for Textiles & Garments

home.heroLead: Born in Egypt with an Italian soul, Egytaltex is a vertical house crafting premium yarn, fabric and garments for an elite clientele — because we truly love what we do.
home.introTitle: A small vertical house, an outsized standard of quality.
home.introBody: Founded in 2001 on Egyptian land but with an Italian mentality, Egytaltex grew, season after season, into a compact vertical company built to fulfil the needs of our elite clients. From yarn to finished garment, we keep every step close — and we do it our way.
home.pillarsTitle: Four disciplines, one obsession with quality
home.pillar1Body: We source and work the best cotton yarn in the world, the foundation of every piece we make.
home.pillar2Body: Soft, durable, beautifully finished fabrics engineered for comfort and longevity.
home.pillar3Body: Cut, sewn and finished in-house with the patience of true craftspeople.
home.pillar4Body: One roof, full control — from raw fibre to the label, quality is never outsourced.
home.processTitle: From fibre to finished, kept in our own hands
home.step1Body: Only the finest long-staple cotton enters our floor.
home.step2Body: Precision machines tended by experienced hands.
home.step3Body: Colour and hand-feel refined to an exacting standard.
home.step4Body: Tailored, inspected and packed, ready for our clients.
home.ctaBody: Tell us what you need — we build to order for brands who care about how things are made.

company.heroLead: Egytaltex was born in 2001 — Egyptian by ground, Italian by mindset. What began as a love for the craft became a vertical house serving an elite clientele.
company.storyP1: We started with a simple conviction: that textiles made with care feel different in the hand and last longer in the wardrobe. From a modest beginning we built, step by step, a small vertical company — keeping yarn, fabric and garment under one roof.
company.storyP2: Operating from the Free Zone in Nasr City, Cairo, we pair Egyptian heritage in cotton with an Italian sense of refinement. We do love what we do, and we do it our way.
company.value1Body: We would rather make less, beautifully, than more, carelessly.
company.value2Body: Owning the full chain means quality answers to us alone.
company.value3Body: We build for clients who notice — and reward — the details.
company.value4Body: The best world cotton, treated with the respect it deserves.
company.t2001: Founded in Cairo with an Italian mentality and a love of craft.
company.t2008: Expanded into a vertical setup — yarn to garment under one roof.
company.t2015: Refined our finishing to serve a growing elite clientele.
company.tToday: A trusted house for brands who value how things are made.

products.heroLead: A focused range, made vertically and finished by hand. Every category begins with the best cotton yarn in the world.

products.featureTitle: Built to order, finished to last
products.featureBody: We do not mass-produce. Each program is developed with the client, sampled with care and produced under our own roof so quality is never left to chance.

clients.heroLead: We craft quietly for an elite clientele — brands and houses that value how a thing is made as much as how it looks.
clients.bodyTitle: Trusted by those who notice the details
clients.bodyText: Our clients return not for the lowest price, but for the surest quality. We work as a partner: developing programs, protecting standards, and delivering with the consistency a serious brand requires.
clients.sisterText: Egytaltex is part of a small family of aligned textile ventures, allowing us to keep more of the process close and our standards uncompromised.
clients.testimonialQuote: “They treat our product like their own. The hand-feel, the finishing, the consistency — it is exactly why we keep coming back.”
